description: This Java class handles deserialization and validation of JSON input for creating and updating accounting rules within the Fineract project. It uses helper classes to parse JSON, perform validation, and check for supported parameters, throwing exceptions on invalid input.

classes.name: AccountingRuleCommandFromApiJsonDeserializer
classes.description: This class provides methods to validate and deserialize JSON input related to accounting rules, ensuring correctness and supported parameters before processing.

methods.name: validateForCreate
methods.description: Validates the JSON input for creating a new accounting rule, checking mandatory fields, parameter types, ranges, and supported parameters.

methods.name: validateForUpdate
methods.description: Validates the JSON input for updating an existing accounting rule, similar to validateForCreate but allowing nulls where applicable.

methods.name: throwExceptionIfValidationWarningsExist
methods.description: Throws an exception if there are any validation errors collected during validation.

methods.name: validateCreditOrDebitTagArray
methods.description: Validates each string in the given credit/debit tags array, ensuring they are not blank and greater than zero if numeric conversion is applied.
